description: This file defines the CustomerApproval model class for the OpenCart admin customer module. It provides functions to retrieve, delete, approve, and deny customer and affiliate approvals, interacting with database tables related to customer approval process.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Model class that manages customer and affiliate approval records, including retrieval, deletion, and approval/denial actions.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes all approval records for a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approval records filtered by specified criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Retrieves a specific customer approval record by its ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Counts total approval records matching specified filters.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Approves a customer by setting status to active and removing approval record.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Deletes approval record for a customer, effectively denying approval.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Sets customer affiliate status to active and removes pending approval.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes approval record for an affiliate, effectively denying approval.
